shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'navigation|@gravity-ui/table' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @tanstack/react-table'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100 && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && sed -n '452,476p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Select Modal TextInput Checkbox Pagination && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -150'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Select Modal TextInput Checkbox Pagination && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && head -140 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | head -85'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '/(Button|Select|Modal|TextInput|Checkbox|DropdownMenu|Switch)/.*(types|Button|Modal|TextInput|Checkbox|Switch)\\.d.ts"'$'"' && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -20 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 65 'CSS API|renderFooter|aboveMenuContent|iconSize|customBackground' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -155 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -125 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -150"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -130 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(House|Persons|ShoppingBag|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ArrowDownRight|ArrowChevronDown|ArrowChevronRight|ArrowChevronLeft|Bars|LayoutColumns|Sliders|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Clock|Xmark|Ellipsis|Calendar|Circles|Chevrons|ArrowRightFromSquare|Envelope|CircleDollar|Bag|Layers|ArrowRotateRight)' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 95 '"'^## CSS|''^### CSS|--gn-'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -125 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head -145 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.js | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -105 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -75 && npm ls react @bem-react/classname @gravity-ui/icons --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '511,566p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text|line)-(positive|success|info|utility|warning|neutral|float|simple|generic|misc)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -75 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | tail -32 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -95 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -55"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--gn-.*(width|size)|--gn-aside-header-item-(.*color|expanded-radius)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*/*.css | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | sed -n '30,110p' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css | head -55 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Bell|ArrowUpRight|ArrowDownToLine|Calendar|ArrowRightFromSquare|BarsUnaligned|ArrowRotateRight|ArrowRight|Receipt|CreditCard)\\.' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'getIsGroupHeaderRow|renderGroupHeaderRowContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/useRowContent.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js | head -115 && cat index.html && git diff --stat && rg -n 'size:|--g-text-display' src/App.tsx src/styles.css | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm | rg 'useRowContent|useRowSelectionFixedHandler' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && git diff --stat && rg -n 'font-size|font-family' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -12 && rg -n -C 3 'size|renderContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '65,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.js | head -70 && cat .gitignore && rg -n 'font-family|font-weight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js && wc -c node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css && rg -n 'fonts|font-face' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -8 && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 5 'renderGroupHeader|getIsGroupHeaderRow|selection' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'React__default.createElement|Sortable' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js | head -90 && sed -n '115635,115720p' /tmp/kontur-smoke.cjs | head -85 && cat vite.config.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js | head -38"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'order-th|metric-value|metric-card|border-radius: 20|table-scroll|form-label' src/styles.css | head -30 && git diff --numstat"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-button-(background-color|text-color|border-color)|--g-text-input-border' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | head -24 && cat package.json && sed -n '75,135p' src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"
